title: RAG source-mapping batches
description: Organizes all remaining RAG source-mapping blockers into human-review batches without applying mapping decisions or enabling runtime retrieval.
priority_rules: Batch 1: source-title groups with three or more chunks.
Batch 2: source-title groups with two chunks.
Batch 3: singleton groups with candidate source suggestions.
Batch 4: singleton groups without candidate source suggestions.
notes: RAG-015 is a batch packet only.
No source mappings are accepted by this checkpoint.
